tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Search real product deals across DiscountHub merchants using keywords and filters.

tools.name: find_promo_codes
tools.description: Find active coupon entries in DiscountHub; checkout acceptance depends on merchant conditions.

tools.name: get_store_offers
tools.description: Find both product discounts and promotions at a named merchant, reporting partial failures.

tools.name: get_best_deals
tools.description: Find deals ranked by percentage discount; not an independent guarantee of product quality or value.

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: List stores from canonical deal facets and promotion store directory.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List categories from canonical live deal facets.

tools.name: get_offer_details
tools.description: Look up a specific deal or promotion by its exact ID via DiscountHub API.

tools.name: compare_deals
tools.description: Compare two searches using real catalogue results; does NOT certify identical products.
